test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an election there were only two candidates. 20% of the voters did not cast their votes and 1000 votes were declared invalid. The winner, by obtaining 70% of the total valid votes, defeated his rival by 1200 votes. The total number of voters in the election was ________.
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of voters did not cast their votes = 20%

Invalid votes = 1000

Winner votes = 70% of valid votes

Winner candidate defeated his rival by = 1200 votes

**Calculation:**

According to question, 

30% of the total valid votes = 1200

⇒ 0.3 × Total valid votes = 1200

⇒ Total valid votes = 1200/0.3 = 4000

Now, Total voters = 4000 + 1000 = 5000

**Hence, the Total voters are 5000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the total valid votes be 100 

Now winning candidate received 70% votes, 

hence losing candidate will get 30% votes, 

The difference between them is, 

⇒ 70% - 30% = 40%

Now as per the question, 

⇒ 40% = 1200

⇒ 1% = 30

Hence, total valid votes, 

⇒ 100% = 100 × 30 = 3000

Invalid votes = 1000

Now, total casted votes = 3000 + 1000 = 4000

20% did not cast their votes, 

Hence, 80% = 4000

⇒ 1% = 4000/80 = 50

⇒ 100% = 50 × 100 = 5000

**∴ The number of voters is 5000.**
